# Linear algebra begins with a scalar field and a vector space over that field.

# A field packages scalar operations together with the laws used below.
struct Field<K nonempty_set>:
    zero K
    one K
    add fn(x, y K) K
    neg fn(x K) K
    mul fn(x, y K) K
    inv fn(x K) K

        forall x, y, z K:
            add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z))
            mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z))
            mul(x, add(y, z)) = add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z))
        forall x, y K:
            add(x, y) = add(y, x)
            mul(x, y) = mul(y, x)
        forall x K:
            add(zero, x) = x
            add(x, neg(x)) = zero
            mul(one, x) = x
        forall x K:
            x != zero
            =>:
                mul(x, inv(x)) = one

# A vector space over one fixed scalar field stores its vector operations and
# compatibility laws as one first-class object.

struct VectorSpace<K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set>:
    zero V
    add fn(x, y V) V
    smul fn(a K, x V) V
    <=>:
        forall x, y, z V:
            add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z))
        forall x, y V:
            add(x, y) = add(y, x)
        forall x V:
            add(zero, x) = x
            exist y V st {add(x, y) = zero}
        forall a, b K, x V:
            smul(field.mul(a, b), x) = smul(a, smul(b, x))
            smul(field.add(a, b), x) = add(smul(a, x), smul(b, x))
        forall a K, x, y V:
            smul(a, add(x, y)) = add(smul(a, x), smul(a, y))
        forall x V:
            smul(field.one, x) = x

# Any element acting as a left additive identity must equal the stored zero.

thm additive_identity_unique:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, identity_candidate V:
        forall x V:
            space.add(identity_candidate, x) = x
        =>:
            identity_candidate = space.zero
    space.add(identity_candidate, space.zero) = space.zero
    space.add(identity_candidate, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, identity_candidate) = identity_candidate

# Existence comes from the vector-space law; associativity and commutativity
# show that any two additive inverses coincide.

thm additive_inverse_exists_unique:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, x V:
        exist! y V st {space.add(x, y) = space.zero}
    obtain y from exist y V st {space.add(x, y) = space.zero}
    forall y1, y2 V:
        space.add(x, y1) = space.zero
        space.add(x, y2) = space.zero
        =>:
            space.add(y2, x) = space.add(x, y2) = space.zero
            y1 = space.add(space.zero, y1) = space.add(space.add(y2, x), y1) = space.add(y2, space.add(x, y1)) = space.add(y2, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, y2) = y2
            y1 = y2
    witness exist! y2 V st {space.add(x, y2) = space.zero} from y

template<K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>>:
    have fn vector_neg by exist!:
        ? forall x V:
            exist! y V st {space.add(x, y) = space.zero}

thm vector_neg_spec:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, x V:
        space.add(x, \vector_neg<K, field, V, space>(x)) = space.zero

template<K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>>:
    have fn vector_sub(u, v V) V = space.add(u, \vector_neg<K, field, V, space>(v))

# Add the inverse of the common left operand to both sides.

thm add_left_cancel:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, x, y, z V:
        space.add(x, y) = space.add(x, z)
        =>:
            y = z
    let neg = \vector_neg<K, field, V, space>
    by thm vector_neg_spec(K, field, V, space, x) => space.add(x, neg(x)) = space.zero
    space.add(neg(x), x) = space.add(x, neg(x)) = space.zero
    space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, y)) = space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), y)
    space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), y) = space.add(space.zero, y) = y
    space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, z)) = space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), z)
    space.add(space.add(neg(x), x), z) = space.add(space.zero, z) = z
    y = space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, y)) = space.add(neg(x), space.add(x, z)) = z

# Compare 0*x with 0*x + 0*x and cancel to derive the zero-scalar law.

thm vector_space_scalar_constants_in_carrier:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>:
        field.zero $in K
        field.one $in K
    field.zero $in K
    field.one $in K

thm zero_scalar_times_vector:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, x V:
        space.smul(field.zero, x) = space.zero
    have p V = space.smul(field.zero, x)
    field.add(field.zero, field.zero) = field.zero
    space.smul(field.add(field.zero, field.zero), x) = space.add(space.smul(field.zero, x), space.smul(field.zero, x))
    space.smul(field.add(field.zero, field.zero), x) = space.smul(field.zero, x) = p
    space.add(space.smul(field.zero, x), space.smul(field.zero, x)) = space.add(p, p)
    p = space.add(p, p)
    space.add(p, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, p) = p
    space.add(p, p) = space.add(p, space.zero)
    release thm add_left_cancel(K, field, V, space, p, p, space.zero)
    p = space.zero

# Distribute a scalar over 0+0, then cancel the repeated term.

thm scalar_times_zero_vector:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, a K:
        space.smul(a, space.zero) = space.zero
    have q V = space.smul(a, space.zero)
    space.add(space.zero, space.zero) = space.zero
    space.smul(a, space.add(space.zero, space.zero)) = space.smul(a, space.zero) = q
    space.smul(a, space.add(space.zero, space.zero)) = space.add(space.smul(a, space.zero), space.smul(a, space.zero)) = space.add(q, q)
    q = space.add(q, q)
    space.add(q, space.zero) = space.add(space.zero, q) = q
    space.add(q, q) = space.add(q, space.zero)
    by thm add_left_cancel(K, field, V, space, q, q, space.zero) => q = space.zero

prop is_linear_map(K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, W nonempty_set, source &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, target &VectorSpace<K, field, W>, T fn(v V) W):
    forall u, v V:
        T(source.add(u, v)) = target.add(T(u), T(v))
    forall a K, v V:
        T(source.smul(a, v)) = target.smul(a, T(v))

# A subspace contains zero and is closed under vector addition and scalar action.

prop is_subspace(K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, space &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, U power_set(V)):
    space.zero $in U
    forall u, v V:
        u $in U
        v $in U
        =>:
            space.add(u, v) $in U
    forall a K, v V:
        v $in U
        =>:
            space.smul(a, v) $in U

template<V, W set, zeroW W, T fn(v V) W>:
    have linear_kernel power_set(V) = {x V: T(x) = zeroW}

template<V set, zeroV V>:
    have zero_subspace power_set(V) = {zeroV}

# Additivity forces the image of zero to be the target zero vector.

thm linear_map_sends_zero_to_zero:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, W nonempty_set, source &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, target &VectorSpace<K, field, W>, T fn(v V) W:
        $is_linear_map(K, field, V, W, source, target, T)
        =>:
            T(source.zero) = target.zero
    source.add(source.zero, source.zero) = source.zero
    T(source.add(source.zero, source.zero)) = target.add(T(source.zero), T(source.zero))
    target.add(T(source.zero), T(source.zero)) = T(source.add(source.zero, source.zero)) = T(source.zero)
    target.add(T(source.zero), target.zero) = target.add(target.zero, T(source.zero)) = T(source.zero)
    target.add(T(source.zero), T(source.zero)) = target.add(T(source.zero), target.zero)
    by thm add_left_cancel(K, field, W, target, T(source.zero), T(source.zero), target.zero) => T(source.zero) = target.zero

# Apply the map to x + (-x) and use uniqueness of the target inverse.

thm linear_map_sends_neg_to_neg:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, W nonempty_set, source &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, target &VectorSpace<K, field, W>, T fn(v V) W, x V:
        $is_linear_map(K, field, V, W, source, target, T)
        =>:
            T(\vector_neg<K, field, V, source>(x)) = \vector_neg<K, field, W, target>(T(x))
    let source_neg = \vector_neg<K, field, V, source>
    let target_neg = \vector_neg<K, field, W, target>
    by thm vector_neg_spec(K, field, V, source, x) => source.add(x, source_neg(x)) = source.zero
    by thm vector_neg_spec(K, field, W, target, T(x)) => target.add(T(x), target_neg(T(x))) = target.zero
    by thm linear_map_sends_zero_to_zero(K, field, V, W, source, target, T) => T(source.zero) = target.zero
    T(source.add(x, source_neg(x))) = target.add(T(x), T(source_neg(x)))
    T(source.add(x, source_neg(x))) = T(source.zero) = target.zero
    target.add(T(x), T(source_neg(x))) = target.zero
    target.add(T(x), target_neg(T(x))) = target.zero
    target.add(T(x), T(source_neg(x))) = target.add(T(x), target_neg(T(x)))
    by thm add_left_cancel(K, field, W, target, T(x), T(source_neg(x)), target_neg(T(x))) => T(source_neg(x)) = target_neg(T(x))
    T(\vector_neg<K, field, V, source>(x)) = T(source_neg(x)) = target_neg(T(x)) = \vector_neg<K, field, W, target>(T(x))

# Verify zero membership and closure under addition and scalar multiplication
# for the native set-builder kernel.

thm linear_map_kernel_is_subspace:
    ? forall K nonempty_set, field &Field<K>, V nonempty_set, W nonempty_set, source &VectorSpace<K, field, V>, target &VectorSpace<K, field, W>, T fn(v V) W:
        $is_linear_map(K, field, V, W, source, target, T)
        =>:
            $is_subspace(K, field, V, source, \linear_kernel<V, W, target.zero, T>)
    let kernel = \linear_kernel<V, W, target.zero, T>
    by thm linear_map_sends_zero_to_zero(K, field, V, W, source, target, T) => T(source.zero) = target.zero
    kernel = {x V: T(x) = target.zero}
    by thm set_builder_member(source.zero, {x V: T(x) = target.zero}) => source.zero $in {x V: T(x) = target.zero}
    source.zero $in kernel
    claim:
        ? forall u, v V:
            u $in kernel
            v $in kernel
            =>:
                source.add(u, v) $in kernel
        u $in {x V: T(x) = target.zero}
        T(u) = target.zero
        v $in {x V: T(x) = target.zero}
        T(v) = target.zero
        T(source.add(u, v)) = target.add(T(u), T(v)) = target.add(target.zero, target.zero) = target.zero
        by thm set_builder_member(source.add(u, v), {x V: T(x) = target.zero}) => source.add(u, v) $in {x V: T(x) = target.zero}
        source.add(u, v) $in kernel
    claim:
        ? forall a K, v V:
            v $in kernel
            =>:
                source.smul(a, v) $in kernel
        v $in {x V: T(x) = target.zero}
        T(v) = target.zero
        by thm scalar_times_zero_vector(K, field, W, target, a) => target.smul(a, target.zero) = target.zero
        T(source.smul(a, v)) = target.smul(a, T(v)) = target.smul(a, target.zero) = target.zero
        by thm set_builder_member(source.smul(a, v), {x V: T(x) = target.zero}) => source.smul(a, v) $in {x V: T(x) = target.zero}
        source.smul(a, v) $in kernel
    by def $is_subspace(K, field, V, source, \linear_kernel<V, W, target.zero, T>)

# Injectivity turns T(x)=0=T(0) into x=0, proving kernel(T)={0}.

# Topology — open sets and continuity, setting-first.
#
# All set constructions below are native Litex objects.  In particular,
# arbitrary unions use family_union and preimages use set builders.

prop TopologicalSpaceSetting(X set, open_sets power_set(power_set(X))):
    {} $in open_sets
    X $in open_sets
    forall U, V open_sets:
        intersect(U, V) $in open_sets
    forall family power_set(power_set(X)):
        family $subset open_sets
        =>:
            family_union(family) $in open_sets

prop is_topology_on(X set, open_sets power_set(power_set(X))):
    $TopologicalSpaceSetting(X, open_sets)

thm topology_triple_intersection:
    ? forall X set, open_sets power_set(power_set(X)), A open_sets, B open_sets, open_C open_sets:
        $TopologicalSpaceSetting(X, open_sets)
        =>:
            intersect(intersect(A, B), open_C) $in open_sets
    intersect(A, B) $in open_sets

# A set-builder family remains well-defined even when A = B; a
# two-element set literal would incorrectly require them to be distinct.
thm topology_binary_union:
    ? forall X set, open_sets power_set(power_set(X)), A open_sets, B open_sets:
        $TopologicalSpaceSetting(X, open_sets)
        =>:
            union(A, B) $in open_sets
    have family power_set(power_set(X)) = {candidate power_set(X): candidate = A or candidate = B}
    claim:
        ? family $subset open_sets
        claim:
            ? forall candidate family:
                candidate $in open_sets
            candidate $in {choice power_set(X): choice = A or choice = B}
            candidate = A or candidate = B
            by cases:
                ? candidate $in open_sets
                case candidate = A:
                    candidate $in open_sets
                case candidate = B:
                    candidate $in open_sets
        by def:
            ? family $subset open_sets
    family_union(family) $in open_sets
    by extension:
        ? family_union(family) = union(A, B)
        claim:
            ? forall point family_union(family):
                point $in union(A, B)
            obtain candidate from exist source_candidate family st {point $in source_candidate}
            candidate $in {choice power_set(X): choice = A or choice = B}
            candidate = A or candidate = B
            by cases:
                ? point $in union(A, B)
                case candidate = A:
                    point $in A
                    point $in union(A, B)
                case candidate = B:
                    point $in B
                    point $in union(A, B)
        claim:
            ? forall point union(A, B):
                point $in family_union(family)
            point $in A or point $in B
            by cases:
                ? point $in family_union(family)
                case point $in A:
                    A = A or A = B
                    by thm set_builder_member(A, {choice power_set(X): choice = A or choice = B}) => A $in {choice power_set(X): choice = A or choice = B}
                    A $in family
                    point $in family_union(family)
                case point $in B:
                    B = A or B = B
                    by thm set_builder_member(B, {choice power_set(X): choice = A or choice = B}) => B $in {choice power_set(X): choice = A or choice = B}
                    B $in family
                    point $in family_union(family)

prop TopologicalMapSetting(X set, open_sets_X power_set(power_set(X)), Y set, open_sets_Y power_set(power_set(Y)), f fn(x X) Y):
    $TopologicalSpaceSetting(X, open_sets_X)
    $TopologicalSpaceSetting(Y, open_sets_Y)

prop ContinuousMapSetting(X set, open_sets_X power_set(power_set(X)), Y set, open_sets_Y power_set(power_set(Y)), f fn(x X) Y):
    $TopologicalMapSetting(X, open_sets_X, Y, open_sets_Y, f)
    forall open_Y open_sets_Y:
        {x X: f(x) $in open_Y} $in open_sets_X

prop is_continuous(X set, open_sets_X power_set(power_set(X)), Y set, open_sets_Y power_set(power_set(Y)), f fn(x X) Y):
    $ContinuousMapSetting(X, open_sets_X, Y, open_sets_Y, f)

prop ContinuousCompositionSetting(A set, open_sets_A power_set(power_set(A)), B set, open_sets_B power_set(power_set(B)), CarrierC set, open_sets_C power_set(power_set(CarrierC)), f fn(x A) B, g fn(y B) CarrierC):
    $TopologicalSpaceSetting(A, open_sets_A)
    $TopologicalSpaceSetting(B, open_sets_B)
    $TopologicalSpaceSetting(CarrierC, open_sets_C)
    forall open_B open_sets_B:
        {x A: f(x) $in open_B} $in open_sets_A
    forall open_C open_sets_C:
        {y B: g(y) $in open_C} $in open_sets_B

# Tracer theorem: settings carry the ambient hypotheses; the proof works with
# the native preimage set builders directly.
thm continuous_composition:
    ? forall A set, open_sets_A power_set(power_set(A)), B set, open_sets_B power_set(power_set(B)), CarrierC set, open_sets_C power_set(power_set(CarrierC)), f fn(x A) B, g fn(y B) CarrierC:
        $ContinuousCompositionSetting(A, open_sets_A, B, open_sets_B, CarrierC, open_sets_C, f, g)
        =>:
            $is_continuous(A, open_sets_A, CarrierC, open_sets_C, fn(x A) CarrierC {g(f(x))})
    claim:
        ? forall target_open open_sets_C:
            {x A: g(f(x)) $in target_open} $in open_sets_A
        {y B: g(y) $in target_open} $in open_sets_B
        have middle_open open_sets_B = {y B: g(y) $in target_open}
        {x A: f(x) $in middle_open} $in open_sets_A
        have nested_preimage open_sets_A = {x A: f(x) $in middle_open}
        have direct_preimage power_set(A) = {x A: g(f(x)) $in target_open}
        claim:
            ? nested_preimage $subset direct_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point nested_preimage:
                    point $in direct_preimage
                f(point) $in middle_open
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {x A: g(f(x)) $in target_open}) => point $in {x A: g(f(x)) $in target_open}
            by def:
                ? nested_preimage $subset direct_preimage
        claim:
            ? direct_preimage $subset nested_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point direct_preimage:
                    point $in nested_preimage
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(f(point), {y B: g(y) $in target_open}) => f(point) $in {y B: g(y) $in target_open}
                f(point) $in middle_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {x A: f(x) $in middle_open}) => point $in {x A: f(x) $in middle_open}
            by def:
                ? direct_preimage $subset nested_preimage
        by extension:
            ? nested_preimage = direct_preimage
        direct_preimage $in open_sets_A
    claim:
        ? forall target_open open_sets_C:
            {candidate A: fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(candidate) $in target_open} $in open_sets_A
        have direct_preimage open_sets_A = {candidate A: g(f(candidate)) $in target_open}
        have literal_preimage power_set(A) = {candidate A: fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(candidate) $in target_open}
        claim:
            ? literal_preimage $subset direct_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point literal_preimage:
                    point $in direct_preimage
                fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(point) = g(f(point))
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {candidate A: g(f(candidate)) $in target_open}) => point $in {candidate A: g(f(candidate)) $in target_open}
            by def:
                ? literal_preimage $subset direct_preimage
        claim:
            ? direct_preimage $subset literal_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point direct_preimage:
                    point $in literal_preimage
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(point) = g(f(point))
                fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(point) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {candidate A: fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(candidate) $in target_open}) => point $in {candidate A: fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(candidate) $in target_open}
            by def:
                ? direct_preimage $subset literal_preimage
        by extension:
            ? literal_preimage = direct_preimage
        literal_preimage $in open_sets_A
    by def:
        ? $is_continuous(A, open_sets_A, CarrierC, open_sets_C, fn(x A) CarrierC {g(f(x))})

prop is_closed(X set, open_sets power_set(power_set(X)), F power_set(X)):
    $TopologicalSpaceSetting(X, open_sets)
    set_minus(X, F) $in open_sets

prop has_closed_preimages(X set, open_sets_X power_set(power_set(X)), Y set, open_sets_Y power_set(power_set(Y)), f fn(x X) Y):
    $TopologicalMapSetting(X, open_sets_X, Y, open_sets_Y, f)
    forall F power_set(Y):
        $is_closed(Y, open_sets_Y, F)
        =>:
            $is_closed(X, open_sets_X, {x X: f(x) $in F})

thm preimage_of_relative_complement:
    ? forall X, Y set, f fn(x X) Y, F power_set(Y):
        {x X: f(x) $in set_minus(Y, F)} = set_minus(X, {x X: f(x) $in F})
    by extension:
        ? {x X: f(x) $in set_minus(Y, F)} = set_minus(X, {x X: f(x) $in F})
        claim:
            ? forall point {x X: f(x) $in set_minus(Y, F)}:
                point $in set_minus(X, {x X: f(x) $in F})
            point $in X
            f(point) $in set_minus(Y, F)
            not f(point) $in F
            claim:
                ? not point $in {x X: f(x) $in F}

#
# Included: the Newton update, a checked executable step, a recursive iterate,

#
#   4 * x_n^2 * g_(n+1) = g_n^2
#                         =>
#   g_(n+1) <= g_n^2 / 4

#   g_n <= 4 * (1 / 4)^(2^n)
